Reuse editAction transaction wrapper, halt disabling, pending-load cancellation, error message, history/save/load. Require explicit cover chart and nonblank numeric inputs; omit chartId entirely for bounded endpoints. Construction forward/up are local author-frame components; state entering direction toward negative forward from positive side. Pair created together with three user-visible IDs and shared radius. No browser/queue/full-suite from clone: lead runs on integrated main. Run node --check and focused Node tests if useful. No weakened existing assertions, no shader fixes, no commits/pushes/delegation. Report under500 words with evidence and limits. Stop if API contract contradicts required behavior.
